personality_one_liner: A sharp, live operational surface built for fast scanning and zero-friction insights, powered by an AI coach that keeps the trader accountable.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly, avoid extra spaces. Keep padding/margins subtle and functional. Tight spacing (sm/md) preferred for dense data blocks.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary to maintain high-contrast readability.
Use dividers over shadows to separate dense information.
dont's: No blur or glassmorphism on cards, lists, or metrics.
No drop shadows; rely on color lightness differences.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Command center for the trader to view real-time equity curve, P&L stats, and access quick actions.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for chart and stat cards.
states.empty: No trades logged yet. Display 'empty_dashboard' image with 'Upload your first trade' CTA.
states.error: Failed to load dashboard data. Retry button.

screens.layout: Top section: Large Account Balance & Daily P&L (color-coded). Middle section: Interactive Equity Curve Chart with 1D/1W/1M segmented controls above it. Bottom section: 2-column grid for Key Metrics (Win Rate, Profit Factor, Best Setup). Floating action button (FAB) in brand Primary for 'Upload Trade'.

screens.name: AI Coach
screens.purpose: Conversational interface delivering daily session reports, strategy critiques, and emotional feedback.

states.empty: AI greeting asking 'How was today's session?'
states.error: Could not connect to AI. Retry.

screens.layout: Full-height scrollable chat layout. AI insight cards injected into the chat flow featuring horizontal stat bars (e.g., 'Discipline Score'). Bottom pinned input field. Use 'ai_coach_avatar' for AI's messages.

screens.name: Trade Journal
screens.purpose: Filterable archive of all trades grouped by strategy, date, and performance.
screens.layout: Sticky top bar with horizontal scrollable chips for filtering (Strategy, A-F Grade). Vertical list of trades. Each row: Ticker/Asset left-aligned, right-aligned P&L (success/error color), and an A-F grade badge. A subtle left-border color strip indicates win/loss.

screens.name: Trade Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific trade with chart screenshot analysis and rule checks.

states.loading: Skeleton over image hero and stats.

screens.layout: Hero image at top (uploaded chart screenshot) with vertical top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Trade grade and P&L positioned at bottom of image. Below image: Rule Violations checklist (red icons for violated rules), and an AI Summary paragraph.

screens.name: Strategy Builder
screens.purpose: Form to define trading rules so the AI can check for violations post-trade.
screens.layout: Single-column stacked form. Fields: Strategy Name, Risk %, and a dynamic list of 'Rules' (e.g., 'No trading on Fridays'). Bottom sticky CTA: 'Save Strategy' spanning full width.

ai_coach_avatar.alt: AI robotic brain circuit in dark mode

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility guidelines: Do not use glassmorphism, stick to solid surface dividers to segregate dense metrics.
Implement Bebas Neue or Rajdhani for large financial numbers, ensuring numbers look sharp and impactful.
Ensure 'success' (Green) and 'error' (Red) are the only colors used for P&L semantics. Do not use blue for generic accents; stick to the Amber 'brand' token for UI actions and premium AI coach hints.
For the Trade Detail screen, the uploaded trade screenshot MUST have a vertical gradient scrim overlay to guarantee text contrast at the bottom.
Make the 'Upload Trade' action highly accessible—either a persistent FAB or a dedicated center tab in the bottom bar.
AI coach chat should feel conversational but data-rich; inject small 'Insight Cards' (e.g. Rule Violations, Mindset Score) directly into the chat flow.
Always maintain a strict WCAG AA contrast ratio on the dark surfaces, using 'onSurface' and 'onSurfaceSecondary' intelligently.
